answer: One strong defence is hardware-backed personhood: each agent identity must be bound to a single secure-enclave attestation from a real device, verified once and revocable if abused. Cloning an identity then means buying and attesting new hardware, not just spinning up another script - like trying to dock a hundred fake ships at one small wharf, each must show a genuine pearl of hardware proof, and a fleet conjured from the empty tundra of copy-paste accounts simply has no berth.
